name: Christ Character Of
overview: The character of Christ is revealed through His steadfast obedience and reliance on God's Word during temptation, as depicted in Matthew 4:1-6. Despite physical weakness after fasting, He resists the devil's enticements by affirming the authority of Scripture and submitting fully to the Father's will. These verses highlight Christ's humility, faithfulness, and unwavering commitment to holiness, setting the foundation for understanding His altogether lovely and merciful nature.
